name: sr_med
form: a * cube(max(rh, thetae - b * thetaestar - c))

name: sr_hi
form: cube(a * max(rh, thetae + b * thetaestar + c) + max(lf, shf) * d)

name: sr_resid_lin
form: srmed + a * min(lf, b) * (shf - c) - d * sef

name: sr_resid_cube
form: srmed + a * shf * min(lf, b) - c * (max(d, cube(sef)) - e)

name: sr_resid_full
form: srmed + a * min(lf, b) * (shf - c) - d * (max(e, cube(sef)) - f) - g * lhf
